hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A custom-curve AMM hook for Uniswap v4 that routes swaps through Euler lending vaults. In beforeSwap, it deposits input tokens and withdraws output tokens directly from Euler vaults, returning a full BeforeSwapDelta to bypass standard Uniswap AMM pricing, and enforces a custom bonding curve invariant on the updated reserves.
